def is_arid(line: str) -> bool:
        noise_patterns = [
            r'^\s*import ',
            r'^\s*from ',
            r'\bprint\s*\(',
            r'\btime\.sleep\s*\(',
            r'\s*"{3}.*"{3}',
            r'if __name__ == "__main__":',
            r'\bdef\s*\w+\s*:\s*""".*"""',
            r'\b\w+:\s*\w+',
            r'\blogging\.info\s*\(',
        ]
        return any(re.match(pattern, line) for pattern in noise_patterns)
